meta.title: Uganda malaria, district by district
meta.boundaries: HDX COD-AB Uganda (UBOS), 135 districts, valid from 2020-08-24

vaccine.source: Uganda National Malaria Control Division, "Malaria Vaccine introduction and scale up districts (draft)", 9 July 2024, via kamuli.go.ug; plus Apac (national launch site, Gavi 2025)
vaccine.note: Draft list: 99 names for a stated 105 districts. Cities folded into parent districts on the 2020 boundaries. The final list was not published.
